development_device: Nothing Phone (3) / Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 / Nothing OS 4.1
notes: B93 is the current stable Beta 5. It includes dual Plaits-based Macro A/B engines, the Rings-style Resonator, expanded 909 percussion, Turing CV routing, improved MIDI and Ableton Link synchronization, project save/load, USB Direct and master split routing, remote-control support, plus the latest parameter-label corrections.
